## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (52%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Reliability flag is set; the 90% set spans Normal, Benign, InSitu [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 52%, Benign 26%, InSitu 21% | No dominant class |
| Conformal set | Normal, Benign, InSitu | Three classes unseparated |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.43 / 94th percentile | Flagged, atypical image |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 3 of 5 Normal | Mixed neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Benign stroma or fat** (regions 7, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Associated with lower invasive likelihood · Validated
- **Normal lobules** (regions 3, 7, 11) · ↓ invasive · Spot check failed (0/20) · Unreliable
- **Duct-confined atypical cells** (regions 1, 5) · ↓ invasive · Pattern linked to in situ, not invasive; spot check 12/20 · Weak
- **Tumor cell fraction 90%** (regions 4, 8, 9) · context · Top of reference range; sampled regions only [F7] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47 to 0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown faithful. Normal lobules is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Sampled regions 4, 8, 9 are 90% neoplastic nuclei, yet invasive probability is 2%.
- Image looks atypical (94th percentile OOD, reliability 0.43).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 4, 8, 9** — Confirm whether dense tumor nuclei are in situ, atypical, or invasive.
2. **Regions 1, 5** — Assess duct-confined atypia; drafted CK5/6 and ER may help.
3. **Regions 7, 10** — Check pleomorphism and any stromal infiltration.
